Spoken orders skip MarketMan's purchase order: No purchase order gets created in MarketMan, so that order skips any approval you have set up there. MarketMan does not see that order; its invoice goes in the way it does today.

Count, check the pars, then speak what is short: Run your usual MarketMan count and let its pars show what is short from that distributor. Then open our app, say that list, and look over each line before you send.

Best for routine reorders: It suits reorders that need no sign-off. If every order to a distributor needs approval, or that distributor is linked both ways to MarketMan, keep it in MarketMan. Send each distributor's orders from one app only, so the same order never goes out twice.

@graph.name: Three steps, starting with your distributor
@graph.description: Your distributor handles the setup, so no computer or new hardware is needed.

step.name: Check your distributor has the app
step.text: If they do, they open an account for you and upload your guide. Not sure? Get in touch and we can check for you.

step.name: Log in on your phone
step.text: Download the app and sign in; your guide is already loaded.

step.name: Read out the order, then send
step.text: Speak the order, check it, and send. You are done.

@graph.name: Do I need a MarketMan alternative to start speaking my orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. MarketMan already turns your counts and pars into an order and passes it to your suppliers. Where one of your distributors has our app, you can order from that one by voice instead.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than MarketMan?

acceptedAnswer.text: For counts, pars, suggested orders, invoices, recipe costs or approvals across locations, no: we do none of those. We do one job: you say an order in our app for one distributor and check each item first. Where MarketMan has a two-way link with a supplier, we add little for that supplier. If phoning one distributor is what made you look for a MarketMan alternative, that one job may be enough.

@graph.name: Do VoiceOrder Solutions and MarketMan connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. They are separate, and neither one's support team covers the other. Orders said in our app go only to your distributor, so MarketMan never sees them.

@graph.name: How do I receive a delivery I ordered by voice?

acceptedAnswer.text: MarketMan holds no order for it, so check what arrives against your confirmation and its order number. Then enter the invoice in MarketMan as usual.

@graph.name: Can I order from every supplier in the app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only from the distributors that run VoiceOrder Solutions. MarketMan can order from far more suppliers than we reach. Keep those in MarketMan, and ask your other suppliers whether they have our app.

@graph.name: What if the app gets an item or a quantity wrong?

acceptedAnswer.text: You fix it on the review screen before you send: change the item or the amount, or delete the line. That check is the safeguard, and a rushed look can still let a mistake through. An order made by phone or left on voicemail gets no order number from us; only app orders do.

@graph.name: How do I get set up, and what does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your distributor opens your account, and most kitchens send their first order on the day it opens. If your distributor does not have the app, or you cannot tell, contact us and we will put you in touch with whoever handles it. On price, check with your distributor: the app reaches you through them, and we list no price of our own. MarketMan publishes its plans.
